name: exp05_ingress128
hypothesis: 128-bit input halves loading to 512 cycles; predict 802 total; test the cost of 136 BRAM tiles and wider A selection.

name: exp06_no_overlap64
hypothesis: Disable B-load/compute overlap at 64 bits to isolate its contribution; predict 1569 cycles, 255 more than experiment 04.

name: exp07_no_overlap128
hypothesis: Disable overlap at 128 bits; predict 1057 cycles and measure its greater relative importance when loading is faster.

name: exp08_no_overlap32
hypothesis: Disable overlap at 32 bits; predict 2593 cycles to check whether the 255-cycle overlap saving is independent of bandwidth.

name: exp09_boundary64
hypothesis: Register both operand boundaries and matching valid signals after A bank selection; predict 1315 cycles and split the failing BRAM-MUX-DSP path.

name: exp10_boundary128
hypothesis: Test the same boundary register with twice the A-bank count; predict 803 cycles and assess the near-capacity BRAM configuration.

name: exp11_boundary32
hypothesis: Boundary pipeline at 32-bit ingress should add one cycle, giving 2339; it should not fix a bandwidth-limited cycle target by itself.

name: exp12_output64
hypothesis: Two INT32 outputs per beat should halve output serialization to 128 cycles; predict 1187 without changing the matrix work.

name: exp13_output128
hypothesis: Four outputs per beat should reduce output cycles to 64 and total to 1123; compare output benefit with unchanged 1024-cycle loading.

name: exp14_output256
hypothesis: Eight outputs per beat should reduce output to 32 cycles and total to 1091; test diminishing returns and partial-row masks.

name: exp15_output512
hypothesis: One full row per output beat should reach 1075 cycles; test the output parallelism limit while 64-bit loading remains dominant.

name: exp16_in128_out64
hypothesis: Combine 128-bit ingress with two outputs per beat; predict 675 cycles, isolating the same output saving under faster loading.

name: exp17_in128_out128
hypothesis: Symmetric 128-bit transport should reach 611 cycles; compare a balanced port width against the one-word output control.

name: exp18_in128_out256
hypothesis: 128-bit ingress and 256-bit egress should reach 579 cycles; route this candidate to check whether cycle gains survive resource and timing constraints.

name: exp19_distributed_a
hypothesis: Use distributed RAM for small striped A banks while B remains BRAM; predict unchanged 1123 cycles, fewer BRAM tiles and a LUT/timing tradeoff versus experiment 13.

name: exp20_dsp128
hypothesis: Reduce DSP budget to 128 with the same transport and pipeline; predict 1123 cycles and quantify the LUT cost of reserving more DSPs.

name: exp21_dsp220
hypothesis: Use the full 220-DSP budget with the same transport and pipeline; predict 1123 cycles and quantify LUT savings and timing versus the 192-DSP configuration.
